Sandbox_Kleptomaniac_IntervalMinutes_too: Time from a successful theft to the next urge. 0 disables the mechanic.
Sandbox_Kleptomaniac_MaxWeight_tooltip: Weight limit for a single stolen item. 0 disables the mechanic.
Sandbox_Kleptomaniac_RetryMinutes_toolti: If the urge to steal remains unfulfilled, the next attempt is delayed by the specified number of in-game minutes.
